description: She wears a muted purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold woven borders decorate the neckline, bodice, cuffs, center skirt and hem. A decorated narrow belt has a round clasp. An ivory wrap with narrow patterned edging rests loosely around her forearms, with a light underdress showing through the low walking opening. A small pendant and patterned brown closed shoes are visible; her head is bare.
